Trade

Learn about the impact of US-China trade tensions on China’s manufacturing sector. Discover the key areas affected, including reduced export demand, supply chain disruption, increased costs, shift to domestic market, and government support. Find out how Chinese manufacturers are adapting to these challenges and what it means for the global market. Read on to learn what you need to know.

The US-China trade tensions have been a hot topic in recent years, and for good reason. The trade tensions have had a significant impact on China’s manufacturing sector. In this blog post, we will explore what you need to know about this impact.

There are several reasons why there is trade tension between the US and China, including:

 

Trade Imbalance:

The US has a significant trade deficit with China, which means that the US imports more goods from China than it exports to China. This trade imbalance has been a source of tension, with some in the US arguing that China engages in unfair trade practices, such as currency manipulation, that give Chinese companies an unfair advantage.

Intellectual Property Theft:

The US has accused China of stealing American intellectual property, such as patents and trade secrets, through cyber-espionage and other means. This has led to the imposition of tariffs and other trade measures by the US in an effort to protect American companies and intellectual property.

National Security Concerns:

The US has also raised national security concerns about Chinese tech companies, such as Huawei, and has implemented measures to restrict their access to US markets. This has led to further tensions between the two countries, as China has accused the US of unfairly targeting Chinese companies.

Differences in Political and Economic Systems:

The US and China have different political and economic systems, with China being a one-party Communist state and the US being a democratic capitalist country. These differences have led to tensions over issues such as human rights, labour practices, and government intervention in the economy.

The Impact on Manufacturing Environment
Reduced Export Demand:

The US-China trade tensions have resulted in reduced demand for Chinese exports to the United States. This has been a significant blow to China’s manufacturing sector, which has relied heavily on exports to the US. According to the International Monetary Fund, China’s exports to the US fell by 7.8% in 2019, and the trend has continued in subsequent years.

Supply Chain Disruption:

The trade tensions have also disrupted global supply chains, which has had a knock-on effect on China’s manufacturing sector. US companies have been forced to look for alternative suppliers, which has hurt Chinese manufacturers who previously had close ties with US companies. This has led to a reduction in orders for Chinese manufacturers, which has affected their profitability and employment levels.

Increased Costs:

The US-China trade tensions have also led to increased costs for Chinese manufacturers. The tariffs imposed by the US on Chinese goods have made Chinese products more expensive for US consumers, which has reduced demand for these products. In response, Chinese manufacturers have been forced to reduce their prices to remain competitive, which has hurt their profit margins.

Shift to Domestic Market:

The US-China trade tensions have also led to a shift in focus for Chinese manufacturers. With reduced demand for their products in the US, Chinese manufacturers have been forced to look for new markets. One area that has received increased attention is the domestic market. Chinese manufacturers are now looking to cater to the growing middle class in China, which has resulted in an increase in demand for consumer goods.

Government Support:

To mitigate the impact of the US-China trade tensions on China’s manufacturing sector, the Chinese government has taken steps to support its manufacturers. This includes providing tax breaks, subsidies, and other incentives to encourage Chinese manufacturers to focus on the domestic market and to invest in new technologies.

Investment in Technology:

In response to the trade tensions, many Chinese manufacturers have invested heavily in technology to make their operations more efficient and to reduce their reliance on the US market. This has led to increased investment in areas such as robotics, automation, and artificial intelligence.

In conclusion, the US-China trade tensions have had a significant impact on China’s manufacturing sector. Reduced export demand, supply chain disruption, increased costs, a shift to the domestic market, and government support are some of the key areas affected. While the long-term effects of these trade tensions remain uncertain, it is clear that Chinese manufacturers will need to adapt and find new ways to remain competitive in the global market.

Manufacturing

Learn the ins and outs of the product sourcing process with OneLink Holdings’ step-by-step guide. Discover best practices for researching suppliers, negotiating terms, placing orders, and more. Streamline your sourcing process and achieve success with OneLink Holdings.

Are you looking to start your own e-commerce business or expand your existing product line? The key to success is finding the right products to sell at the right price. This is where product sourcing comes in. But where do you start and how do you ensure a smooth and successful product sourcing process? In this blog post, we’ll provide a step-by-step guide to help you source products for your business.

 

Step 1: Identify the products you want to sell

The first step in the product sourcing process is to identify the products you want to sell. Identifying the products you should sell is an important step in starting or growing a successful business. There are several factors to consider when choosing the right products, including market demand, competition, and profitability. To start, consider the needs and wants of your target market. What products are they looking for and what problems can you solve for them? Researching market trends and consumer preferences can also provide valuable insights into what products are in high demand.

Next, consider your competition. What products are they offering and how can you differentiate your offerings? Look for opportunities to offer unique or high-quality products that stand out in the market.

It’s also important to consider the cost and profitability of the products you are considering. Make sure to factor in the cost of goods, shipping, and other expenses to determine a realistic price point for your products. It’s also important to research the profit margins for each product to ensure that you are making a profit.

Finally, consider your own skills and interests when choosing products. Selecting products that align with your personal interests and expertise can make the product sourcing process more enjoyable and increase your chances of success. By considering these factors and conducting thorough research, you can identify the products that are right for your business and set yourself up for success.

Step 2: Research potential suppliers

Once you have identified the products you want to sell, the next step is to find potential suppliers. You can start by searching for suppliers on B2B marketplaces such as Alibaba, Global Sources, and ThomasNet. You can also use search engines like Google to find suppliers. When researching potential suppliers, be sure to consider factors such as product quality, price, delivery time, and customer reviews.

OneLink Holdings can serve as your trusted product sourcing agent, providing expert guidance and support throughout the entire product sourcing process. From identifying potential suppliers, to negotiating prices and terms, to overseeing production and delivery, OneLink Holdings has the expertise and resources to streamline the process and ensure a successful outcome. By using OneLink Holdings as your product sourcing agent, you can save time and resources, minimize risks, and focus on growing your business.

Step 3: Evaluate suppliers

Once you have a list of potential suppliers, the next step is to evaluate them to determine which ones are the best fit for your business. Consider factors such as their experience, product quality, manufacturing capabilities, and pricing. Ordering samples from a manufacturer before placing a large order is an important step in the product sourcing process. Receiving and evaluating samples allows you to inspect the product quality, ensure that it meets your standards, and make any necessary modifications before committing to a larger order. By ordering samples first, you can also confirm that the manufacturer is able to meet your delivery timeline, packaging requirements, and any other important specifications. Furthermore, evaluating samples can help you determine whether the manufacturer is a good fit for your business and whether their prices are competitive. Samples can also help you market and promote the product, as you can use the samples to create product photos and videos, or even use them for customer reviews. In summary, ordering samples from a manufacturer is a crucial step in the product sourcing process that can help you make informed decisions, minimize risks, and ensure a successful outcome.

Step 4: Negotiate terms with suppliers

Once you have identified your preferred suppliers, the next step is to negotiate the terms of your agreement. This may include the price of the products, the minimum order quantity, and the delivery time. Negotiating with suppliers is a critical part of the product sourcing process and can have a significant impact on the success of your business. To get the best price and conditions, it’s important to approach negotiations with a clear understanding of your goals and priorities. First, research the market to determine the average price for the products you want to source. This information can be used as a starting point for negotiations. When communicating with suppliers, be clear and concise about the terms you are looking for, including price, minimum order quantities, and delivery times. It’s also important to be open to compromise and willing to make concessions to reach a mutually beneficial agreement. Consider offering long-term contracts or larger order quantities in exchange for lower prices. Finally, be sure to thoroughly review the terms of the agreement before finalizing the deal to ensure that all conditions are clearly defined and that you are satisfied with the outcome of the negotiations.

Step 5: Place the order

Once you have negotiated the terms with your suppliers, the next step is to place the order. Be sure to review all the details of the order, including the products, quantity, price, and delivery time, before confirming the order. It’s important to also clarify any specific requirements, such as packaging, labelling, and shipping instructions, to ensure that the order is processed correctly. You can expect the supplier to acknowledge receipt of the order and provide a confirmation, including an estimated delivery date. It’s important to communicate regularly with the supplier to track the progress of the order and ensure that everything is going smoothly. The supplier may also request a deposit or full payment upfront, so be prepared to provide payment as needed. Placing an order with a supplier is an exciting step in the product sourcing process, and by taking the time to plan and prepare, you can help ensure a successful outcome.

Step 6: Manage the logistics

The final step in the product sourcing process is to manage the logistics of getting the products to your customers. This may involve working with a logistics company to handle the shipping and delivery of the products. Using a freight forwarder to handle your delivery can be a great way to simplify the logistics of your product sourcing process. A freight forwarder is a company that specializes in organizing and managing the transportation of goods from one location to another. They can handle the entire process, from negotiating rates with shipping companies, to tracking the shipment, to handling customs clearance and delivery to your customers. By using a freight forwarder, you can save time and reduce the stress of managing the delivery of your products. Additionally, freight forwarders often have relationships with multiple shipping companies, allowing them to find the best possible rate for your shipment. This can result in cost savings for your business. It’s important to choose a reputable and experienced freight forwarder to ensure a smooth and successful delivery process.

In conclusion, the product sourcing process is a complex and multi-step process that requires careful planning and execution. From researching potential suppliers, to negotiating terms and conditions, to placing an order and receiving delivery, there are many steps involved in successfully sourcing products. By following a step-by-step guide like the one provided by OneLink Holdings, businesses can streamline the process, minimize risks, and ensure a successful outcome. It’s important to carefully evaluate potential suppliers, order samples to inspect product quality, and clearly communicate with suppliers to ensure that all requirements are met. Utilizing a freight forwarder to handle delivery can also simplify the process and save time and resources. By following a comprehensive guide and taking the time to properly plan and prepare, businesses can successfully source products and achieve their goals.

How to Find Quality Suppliers

Once you have done your research on the different types of products available and the various suppliers who offer them, it’s time to start sourcing potential suppliers who meet your criteria. Additionally, it’s also important to read customer reviews before making any decisions as this can help ensure that you are working with a reputable supplier who provides high-quality goods at competitive prices.

Finding Quality Products

Once you have identified potential suppliers who meet your criteria, it’s time to get down to the nitty-gritty – finding quality products that are customisable for your business needs. To do this effectively, make sure that you discuss all potential options with each supplier before deciding so that they can provide samples and other details about their products and services. Additionally, if possible, try and visit their factory or production centre so that you can get an idea of how they operate and whether or not their products are up-to-scratch with international standards. This will help ensure that when it comes time for delivery; everything runs smoothly without any hiccups along the way!

Minimum Order Quantities for custom merchandising

When it comes to custom merchandise, MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) is an important factor to consider. This refers to the minimum amount of merchandise that needs to be ordered for the purchase to be accepted. The quantity may vary depending on the merchandise chosen and the supplier who’s offering it. Many suppliers understand that businesses come in all shapes and sizes, so some offer flexible MOQs, allowing you to order a smaller or larger quantity depending on your circumstance. It’s always worth double checking with suppliers if your order does not meet their typically accepted MOQ.

Why should businesses use custom merchandising?

Custom merchandise is a great way for businesses to promote their brand and build customer loyalty. It can be used to create merchandise that makes customers smile each time they use it. In addition, merchandise can be tailored to the individual needs of your customers and can contain unique designs and messages about your business or product. By creating merchandise with your branding, you can increase visibility for your business on a global scale, giving your customers pride in wearing or using merchandise that represents you. Furthermore, merchandise can also be used as incentives or rewards for customer loyalty, incentivizing them to keep coming back and spread the word about your business through the merchandise they have acquired. Overall, custom merchandise is an excellent tool to build customer connections and ultimately boost business visibility.

Freight & Logistics

What Is Logistics and Why Does It Matter? | OneLink Holdings

Logistics is the art and science of planning, organizing, and managing resources to ensure goods are produced and delivered in an efficient manner. In other words, it involves the process of getting materials from one place to another in a cost-effective way. It’s not just about transporting products or services—it’s also about making sure that those products are delivered on time, in the right quantity and at the right cost. In today’s globalized world, logistics is becoming increasingly important as companies look for ways to increase efficiency while reducing costs. Let’s take a deeper look into what makes up logistics and why it matters.

What are the 4 types of logistics?

There are 4 main types of logistics: Inbound, Outbound, Reverse and Third-party logistics.  Inbound Logistics involves the receiving and storage of goods from both supplier and vendors, whereas Outbound Logistics follows with the process of selecting, packing and shipping goods from the suppliers and vendors. Reverse Logistics is the process of returning goods from customers and redistributing them to other customers or back to the original supplier. As the name suggests, Third-Party Logistics is the outsourcing of the logistics operations to a third-party provider to fulfill the requirements.

Components of Logistics

Logistics can be divided into five main components: inventory management, warehousing, transportation, order fulfillment and freight management.

Inventory management focuses on tracking what products or services you have available for sale or delivery, when they need to be replenished, how much stock is required to meet customer demand, etc. Warehousing is all about where you store your products or services before they are delivered to customers. Transportation refers to how those products or services get from point A to point B safely and efficiently. Order Fulfillment comes under outbound logistics, as it involves picking, packing and shipping orders efficiently. Finally, freight management is the process of organising freight transport, including negotiating rates and selecting the best carriers to get the goods from A to B.

The Benefits of Logistics

Logistics plays an integral role in businesses that depend on timely delivery of their goods or services. Companies who rely on efficient logistics systems can save time and money by improving their supply chain processes. For example, if a company has an effective inventory management system in place, it can reduce the amount of excess stock it holds; this leads to lower costs as well as faster turnover times for new orders. Additionally, a well-managed transportation system can lead to faster deliveries at lower costs due to better route optimization strategies (for example using fewer trucks but more frequently). Finally, having efficient warehousing systems allows companies to better plan their production cycles since they know exactly how many items need to be produced at any given time without having too much or too little inventory on hand.                                                                                                                                              Logistics is an essential component of any business that relies on timely delivery of goods or services. By breaking down logistics into its core components—inventory management, warehousing, and transportation—companies can identify areas where they can improve efficiency while reducing costs across the board. This ultimately leads to improved customer satisfaction as well as increased profitability for businesses who are able to successfully manage their supply chain processes through effective logistics management strategies. Logistics is no longer just about getting things from Point A to Point B; it’s about doing so in a smart way that reduces costs while maximizing profits!

10 Marketing Trends to Keep Your Business Ahead of the Curve in 2023 | OneLink Holdings

Want to make sure your business is ahead of the curve when it comes to marketing? Check out these ten trends that will be huge in 2023!

Marketing is an ever-evolving industry, and to keep ahead of your competition in 2023 it’s important to stay up to date with the latest trends. As marketers, we know it can be difficult to understand which marketing strategies are working best for businesses like yours — but fear no more! We’ve created this guide of 10 marketing trends you should keep an eye on in 2023 so your business can stay one step ahead.

From influencer marketing tactics to leveraging AI technology, these cutting-edge tips will help position your business at the top of the pack. Continue reading if you want to gain valuable insights about how you can ensure that your company remains at the forefront as we enter the new year!

What are Marketing Trends and why do businesses need to use them?

Marketing trends are the direction a marketing strategy takes over time, and they’re essential to navigating a successful marketing plan for businesses. Staying on top of marketing trends can help you develop approaches for targeting specific audiences, discover new ways of marketing products and understand powerful channels. As well as helping businesses take advantage of current marketing opportunities, understanding marketing trends is also key in predicting future marketing opportunities that may arise. Whether it’s keeping up with changing customer habits or integrating new technologies into your marketing strategy, staying one step ahead with marketing trends is essential for businesses who want to stay competitive in their market.

Here are our top ten recommendations for 2023!

1. AI-Driven Strategies

Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly commonplace as businesses use it to automate processes, predict customer needs, and target personalized advertising campaigns. AI can also help marketers optimize their content for search engine rankings by understanding user intent and providing more accurate search results.

2. Video Content

Video content is a powerful tool for connecting with customers and building awareness around your brand. Companies should prioritize creating video content for social media platforms, websites, emails, and even TV commercials to engage with their target audience. Videos should be fast-paced and easy to digest. Keeping videos short is important, with viewers needing to be hooked within the first 3 seconds of a video for it to be effective. TikTok videos and Instagram and Facebook reels are the most effective way to promote video content that is engaging for viewers.

3. Conversational Commerce

With advancements in technology, customers now expect companies to provide personalized experiences based on their individual needs. This requires businesses to communicate with customers through multiple channels such as chatbots or voice assistants. Conversational commerce allows companies to better understand their customer’s needs and provide them with tailored solutions quickly and efficiently. Facebook Messenger has become a viable customer service channel, which is a more authentic and faster line of communication than other options such as email and phone communication. Another form of customer service communication is through the Instagram Direct Messaging service. This chat function allows customers and the business to to send links and communicate quickly.

4. Hyper-Personalization

Hyper-personalization is all about using data collected from customers’ interactions with your brand across multiple channels – such as website visits, emails opened, etc – to create personalized experiences for each user. By leveraging this data effectively, you can craft customized messages that speak directly to your customers’ interests and needs while still delivering value at scale.

5. Social Media Advertising

Social media platforms have become one of the most popular ways for people to interact online – so it makes sense that businesses would want to capitalize on this trend by investing in social media advertising campaigns. As more people turn towards social media for entertainment purposes, having an effective social media ad strategy can help increase brand visibility and boost sales significantly over time. Features such as Instagram Checkout and Tik Tok Shopping creates another platform for product sales, which provides a cohesive advertising campaign by merging social media and sales platforms.

6. Influencer Marketing

Influencer marketing is a great way for brands to reach large audiences quickly without needing a massive budget or huge amounts of resources. Brands should focus on finding influencers who fit within their target demographic to maximize effectiveness. A trend for 2023 will be the effect Micro-Influencers can have on businesses. Micro-influencers usually have around 100,000 followers or less but are much cheaper to use per post than a large influencer and they also tend to have a more engaged audience and following.

7. Voice Search Optimization

As voice assistants become more popular, it’s important for brands to optimize their websites for voice searches. This means ensuring that website content is optimized for natural language queries, which can be done through keyword research, optimizing page titles, meta descriptions, headings, etc.

8. Mobile Optimization

Mobile optimization has been a priority since before 2020, but it has become even more important now that most people access the internet primarily through their phones or tablets. Companies need to ensure that their websites are optimized for mobile devices, so they don’t miss out on potential customers. If a brand is targeting millennial and Gen Z audiences, mobile optimization expands buying power for these audiences; allowing them to make quick purchases while using their mobile devices.

9. Augmented Reality

Augmented reality (AR) is a technology that allows users view virtual objects in real – life settings via smartphones or other devices. AR can be used by businesses as a powerful marketing tool by creating interactive experiences that engage users in new ways.

10. Automation

Automation tools allow marketers save time by automating tedious tasks such as scheduling posts or responding quickly to customer inquiries. Automation can also be used in email campaigns, allowing companies send personalized messages based on customer behaviour across multiple channels.

These 10 trends are just some of the many innovations taking place in the world of digital marketing today. Keeping up to date with these trends will help ensure your business stays ahead of the competition and drives revenue growth over time! By leveraging new technologies like artificial intelligence, conversational commerce, hyper-personalization, social media advertising, influencer marketing, voice search optimization, mobile optimization, augmented reality, and automation – you ‘ll be well positioned for success in 2023.

The Future of Freight Forwarding in 2023 | OneLink Holdings

Wondering who the top freight forwarders will be in 2023? Look no further! We’ve compiled a list of the most reputable companies to help you stay ahead of the curve.

Freight forwarder companies provide a much-needed service for those who need to transport goods from one place to another. A freight forwarder acts as an intermediary between the shipper and their carrier, providing services such as documentation, customer service, and in some cases warehousing. They provide cost effective solutions for those who don’t want the work or responsibility of managing their own shipments. Additionally, they will ensure that your cargo arrives at its destination safe and on time, taking the worry out of shipping your items overseas.

As technology continues to evolve, the role of freight forwarders has become more important than ever. Not only do these companies ensure that goods are transported from one location to another with minimal delays and disruptions, but they also help businesses reduce costs associated with international shipping. With such a high demand for quality freight forwarding services, it’s no surprise that many of the top players in the industry have been making headlines over the last few years.

In this blog post, we’ll take a look at some of the leading global freight forwarders in 2023.

1. Kuehne + Nagel

This company is headquartered in Switzerland and provides air, sea and road transport solutions to customers around the world. They focus on optimizing their customer’s supply chain and providing innovative transportation solutions for their clients.

2. DHL

DHL is one of the largest logistics companies in the world and has been providing transportation services since 1969. They offer a wide range of services including airfreight, sea freight, customs clearance, warehousing and distribution services.

3. DB Schenker

This company was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Germany. It provides a comprehensive range of services including ocean freight forwarding, truckload shipping, rail freight forwarding, contract logistics and customs brokerage services across North America.

4. XPO Logistics

XPO Logistics is an American-based company that offers global supply chain solutions to customers all over the world. Their services include warehousing & distribution centres, cross-border transportation management, order fulfillment and e-commerce solutions for businesses large and small alike.

5. GEFCO Group

Based out of France, this company provides integrated logistics solutions ranging from air cargo to road transport to rail cargo handling for its customers all over Europe and beyond. They offer an extensive list of services including customs clearance assistance for imports/exports as well as storage facilities for both dry cargo goods as well as hazardous materials goods across Europe.

6. DSV Panalpina A/S

DSV Panalpina is an international transport & logistics provider based out of Denmark offering services from air & ocean freight forwarding to project cargo handling worldwide.

7. Panalpinia Global Forwarding

Panalpinia Global Forwarding is a full-service global logistics provider specialized in offering end-to-end supply chain solutions tailored specifically according to customer needs.

8. Agility Logistics

Agility Logistics is an international transportation & logistics provider based out of Dubai which offers integrated supply chain solutions ranging from global trade compliance knowledge to customs clearance assistance.

9. Sinotrans Ltd

Sinotrans Ltd, founded back in 1997, is a leading provider of integrated logistics solutions specializing in ocean & inland transport, Customs clearance, warehousing & distribution.

10. Yusen Logistics Co Ltd

Yusen Logistics Co Ltd, established back in 1960, specializes in offering complete end-to-end supply chain management solutions ranging from airfreight, sea freight & land transport needs through its network spanning over 150 countries worldwide.

When selecting a freight forwarder for 2023, businesses should use the following criteria: industry expertise, location, services, track record and scale of operations and capacity.

Industry Expertise

Industry expertise is key, as they need to know that the forwarder is familiar with their specific area and will be able to efficiently handle their tasks.

Location

Many forwarders have teams located in different parts of the world, so it’s worth exploring which locations might best be suited to the business’s individual needs.

Services

Services offered are also another prime factor, as this can vary significantly from forwarder to forwarder.

Track Record

It’s also recommended to check out some reviews of forwarders in order to get a better idea of their track record.

Scale of Operations

Finally, businesses should look into the forwarder’s scale of operations and capacity so that their request don’t end up being pushed down the priority list due to an overload of other clients. With these criteria in mind, businesses should be well-prepared for making an informed decision about their forwarder for 2023!

In this blog post we looked at some of the top 10 global freight forwarders expected to be making headlines by 2023 due to their superior quality service offerings within their respective markets worldwide. With such intense competition within this industry sector, it’s essential that each company strive towards providing excellence within their operations while keeping up with current market trends so as not lose potential customers or get left behind when it comes down to meeting customer demands. For clients looking for reliable yet cost effective freight forwarding options, these companies certainly seem like great choices!

Sourcing Activewear in Vietnam: An Overview | OneLink Holdings

Are you looking to source activewear in Vietnam? This overview will give you the information you need to get started, including an industry overview, the top manufacturing companies, and MOQ requirements.

When you think of activewear brands, you think of big names such as Nike and Adidas. But did you know these companies use Vietnam for manufacturing their products? In this blog we will explore the Vietnam Activewear manufacturing market. If you are looking at sourcing activewear from Vietnam, there are a few things to consider before getting started. Things to consider include which manufacturers are the best, what is the industry overview like, and what are the MOQ (minimum order quantity) requirements. Knowing this information upfront can help you make a more informed decision about where to source your activewear in Vietnam. Read on for an overview of sourcing activewear in Vietnam.

Industry Overview

Vietnam’s garment manufacturing industry has experienced tremendous growth over the past decade thanks to its competitive labour costs and strong government support for foreign investment. This has resulted in many well-established companies that specialize in producing high-quality apparel products for both domestic consumption as well as export around the world. In addition to these established companies there are also many smaller businesses that offer competitive prices due to their lower overhead costs.

It’s one of the fastest-growing industries in the country, and sportswear manufacturers can’t keep up with demand. Consumers are seeking more comfortable clothing that keeps up with their active lives, and sportswear makers are responding by creating garments made from premium fabrics to provide maximum breathability and support for athletes. Companies are also introducing innovations like new heat-retaining technologies that help regulate body temperature, which makes sportswear even more attractive to consumers. With plenty of manufacturers entering the market, sportswear manufacturers in Vietnam have an excellent opportunity to expand their business and capture a large portion of the lucrative sportswear market.

Key companies such as Adidas and Nike are using Vietnam to outsource production, with Adidas, for example, having 76 third-party suppliers located in Vietnam, which employs 200,000 workers. Nike also produces approximately 51% of its footwear in Vietnam, using 138 different suppliers around Vietnam: employing an estimated 484,000 workers.

According to Statista, in 2022, US$70 million was spent on sportswear and athletic footwear, with the Vietnamese expected to spend about double that each year until 2027.


Type of Activewear in Vietnam

Vietnam are renowned for their manufacturing capabilities in the textile and garment industry, with many factories supplying international sports brands on a wide scale. Items that can be produced in Vietnam include:

  • T- shirts and hoodies
  • Running shorts, leggings, pants etc
  • Swimsuits
  • Cycling and yoga apparel
  • Various clothing suitable for sports such as soccer, basketball, and volleyball clothes

Sports footwear: including running shoes, cross trainers, football and basketball shoes are also produced in large numbers. International brands such as Nike, Adidas, Under Armour and Puma use Vietnam based manufacturers to complete their lines.

What products are difficult to source in Vietnam?

While sports garments and footwear are relatively easy to find in Vietnam, harder items to source include gym equipment such as weights (dumbbells, barbells and kettlebells), fitness machines such as treadmills and exercise bikes and gym accessories such as resistance bands and skipping ropes. While not impossible to find and purchase, they generally aren’t as competitive in terms of pricing and MOQ requirements that you may find elsewhere.

Finding Reliable Manufacturers

If you’re looking to source sportswear manufacturers in Vietnam, the good news is that the country has grown into a booming sportswear industry due in part to its competitive cost structure and experienced labour force. By taking advantage of this market, you’ll be able to get sportswear manufacturers who specialize in offering a wide range of sportswear products, including customized pieces for teams or individual athletes. It helps too that there are more than 30 sport-related industrial zones and parks that have been created over the last few years, making it easy to find reliable sportswear manufacturers according to your specific needs and goals. Researching the available manufacturers through online directories, social media sites, or forums will help ensure you get top quality sportswear from ethical sources that align with your values.

If you’d prefer a sourcing agent to do the work for you, contact the OneLink Holdings Team info@onelinkholdings.com. Our staff on the ground in Vietnam can source multiple products and quotes to find the best deal that suits your individual needs.

MOQ Requirements

The MOQ requirements vary depending on which manufacturer you choose to work with, but most have relatively low minimums compared to other countries like China or India. Most manufacturers will require anywhere from 100-500 pieces per style/colour combination depending on the complexity of the product design/fabrication process required by that particular style/design. The exact number will depend on your specific needs so make sure you speak with each manufacturer before committing to anything, so you know exactly what their MOQ requirements are.

Top Activewear Manufacturers in Vietnam

When it comes to finding a reliable and reputable activewear manufacturer in Vietnam, there are some key players that stand out from the rest. Here are some of the top manufacturers based on quality, pricing, turnaround times, and customer service ratings:

Vina Apparel

Vina Apparel is in the clothing capital, the Hung Yan province, Ho Chi Minh City. They produce various types of sportswear apparel also specializing in custom-made apparel products. Vina Apparel offers a wide range of fabrics and materials with low minimum order quantities (MOQs). They also provide quality assurance checks at all stages of production.

Viet Long Garment Co Ltd.

This company is in Hanoi City and specializes in producing high-end athletic apparel such as yoga pants, sports bras, and tracksuits. They have an excellent reputation for quality control and can produce custom designs with low MOQs.

Phuong Phap Garment Co.

Phuong Phap is another popular option for sourcing activewear from Vietnam. They specialize in producing tracksuits, tank tops, shorts, leggings, and more with quick turnaround times and low MOQs.

Son Ha Garment Joint Stock Company

Son Ha was established in 1969, in Hanoi Vietnam. As a sportswear and leisurewear manufacturer, they employ 3,400 people in their manufacturing sector. Son Ha export up to 60% of its sportswear to major brands such as Columbia Sportswear, Umbro, Walmart, Costco, Quicksilver and Levi’s.

Sourcing activewear from Vietnam can be an excellent way to get quality products at competitive prices without sacrificing turnaround times or customer service standards. It is important however to do your research beforehand so that you know which manufacturers offer the best quality products at the lowest prices with minimal MOQ requirements suitable for your business needs. By following these tips you should be able to find a reliable activewear supplier in no time! Good luck!

What is Demand Forecasting and Why It’s Important for Businesses | OneLink Holdings

Demand forecasting is the process of predicting future sales or business activity. Learn more about why it’s important, the different methods used, and how it can help your business succeed.

Are you a business owner or marketer who knows there’s always room for improvement when it comes to predicting consumer demand? If so, demand forecasting could be the key to improving your planning and operations. Demand forecasting allows businesses to make smarter decisions about production, stock levels and logistics by considering historical sales data, demographic trends, consumer preferences and more. By using the historical sales data and demographic trends, businesses can predict future needs and consumer demand. In this blog post, we will explore the concept of demand forecasting and discuss why it is important for businesses in today’s ever-evolving marketplace. We will also look at the types and methods of demand forecasting.

What Is Demand Forecasting?

Demand forecasting is the process of predicting the future demand for a product or service. It involves gathering data from past sales history and market research studies, analysing that data to identify trends and patterns and then using those insights to make predictions about future consumer behaviour. Demand forecasting helps businesses plan by providing them with insight into upcoming customer needs, allowing them to better prepare their operations in advance.

The Benefits of Demand Forecasting

There are numerous benefits associated with demand forecasting which include improved planning capabilities, increased revenue potential, lower operational costs, better customer service levels, enhanced competitive advantage and improved decision-making. With accurate forecasts in hand, businesses can plan their production more efficiently, reduce waste due to overproduction or underproduction of goods or services, optimize inventory levels for optimal profit margins, develop pricing strategies that are competitive yet profitable and even anticipate changes in consumer preferences so they can adjust their products accordingly. Furthermore, by understanding upcoming customer needs using demand forecasting methods such as predictive analytics or artificial intelligence (AI), businesses can also provide a higher level of personalized service to customers which will help foster loyalty over time. All these benefits ultimately lead to increased profits for businesses who utilize demand forecasting tools effectively.

Types of Demand Forecasting
  • Passive Demand Forecasting
  • Active Demand Forecasting
  • Short-term Projections
  • Long term Projections
  • External Macro Forecasting
  • Internal Business Forecasting
Passive Demand Forecasting

Passive demand forecasting is an extremely important tool for businesses, as it helps to estimate demand for a particular product or service. This form of demand forecasting involves assessing demand without any extra effort involved, such as creating marketing campaigns. Instead, it analyses trends and patterns in historical demand data to create a forecast for demand in the future. Knowing this information can help businesses optimise their resources and make decisions on what products or services should be provided to meet customer demand. This helps them remain competitive in their markets and maintain a healthy bottom line!

Active Demand Forecasting

Active demand forecasting is a method businesses use to predict demand for a product or service. It’s an important part of running a successful business because demand forecasts help to decide how much demand there will be in the future, enabling companies to better manage their supply chain and operations. Businesses can use demand forecasting by gathering both internal and external data, such as sales records and market data. This is then synthesised into models for predicting future demand which can be used to strategically invest in new supplies, production or other opportunities. Active demand forecasting provides many benefits like maximising potential profits, reducing waste from over-stocking and optimising stock control.

Short-term Projections

Short-term demand forecasting focuses on the next 3 to 12 months in the business. This forecasting is used to manage your just-in-time supply chain. By focusing on the short-term supply, you can adjust projections based on real-time sales data and respond quicker to changes in customer demand.

Long-term Projections

While short-term focuses on 3 to 12 months’ time, long term focuses on 1 to 4 years into the future. This forecasting method is used to shape your business growth trajectory, including your aspirations for business growth. This method also allows for mapping out the bigger picture; with marketing, capital investments and supply chain operations considered.

External Macro Forecasting

External Macro Forecasting involves looking at the big picture to make predictions about macroeconomic trends, like inflation or unemployment rates. By studying relevant macroeconomic data such as GDP and consumer spending, economists can forecast macro trends to gain insight into potential consequences of public policies or actions taken by corporations and individuals. These macro forecasts can be invaluable to businesses and governments alike in helping to make informed decisions that will have a positive impact on their respective economies and population.

Internal Business Forecasting

This process involves collecting internal data like employee productivity, inventory trends, and customer satisfaction surveys to get a thorough understanding of the company’s internal operations. Once the internal forecast is complete, companies can use the insights it provides to create an effective strategy that aligns with their short-term and long-term objectives. The benefits of internal business forecasting are vast; it helps businesses make more informed decisions, plan ahead for changes in the market, and ensure success in the future.

Though demand forecasting can seem daunting at first glance for businesses, with the right tools and knowledge, it can provide powerful insight into their operations and help take their most important decisions to the next level.

Methods of Demand Forecasting

The main methods used to determine demand forecasting are Trend Projection, Market Research, Sales Force Composite and the Delphi Method.

Trend Projection

This method is quite simple to use, as businesses use past sales data to project future sales. It is important to consider historical anomalies when calculating future sales. For example, you may have had a spike in sales after a new product release that is unlikely to continue.

Market Research

Market research demand forecasting involves analysing market data and market trends to assess the market potential of an idea, product or service. Market researchers look at factors such as competition, customer preferences and economic conditions to understand how market trends will affect market size and determine the optimal price points for selling a product or service. The aim is to maximize profits by understanding how products and services fit into the current market environment. Through market research demand forecasting, organizations can develop strategies that capitalize on existing opportunities while minimizing their risk exposure.

Sales Force Composite

Sales Force Composite takes into account patterns and trends in sales so that sales managers have an effective strategy and know the best approach to take with each customer. With sales force composite demand forecasting, sales teams have the insight to determine which products are selling well and how much demand exists on the market for certain products or services. Additionally, this powerful tool can also project future sales volumes, giving sales teams the ability to plan ahead for key sales events and track their success along the way. In short, sales force composite demand forecasting is a tool for sales teams everywhere who want to stay ahead of the competition and make sure their efforts bring results.

Delphi Method

The Delphi Method involves collecting opinions from well-informed experts from multiple fields who share their insights and experiences in order to predict future trends. This technique can help businesses make well informed decisions when forecasting demand for any product or service. All the inputs are collected anonymously with no one’s identity being revealed which further encourages thoughtful and honest opinions that can be useful for long-term market analysis. Delphi is an effective way for businesses to unite varied insights and plot their visions in today’s ever-changing landscape.

Demand forecasting is an essential tool for businesses looking to stay one step ahead of their competitors while maximizing profits at the same time. By accurately predicting future customer demands through gathering data from past sales history and market research studies along with utilizing predictive analytics or AI technology where needed; businesses can improve their planning capabilities as well as decrease operational costs while also increasing revenue potentials through better pricing strategies all leading up to enhanced competitive advantage and improved decision-making capabilities in general. Ultimately providing customers with better experiences through personalized service resulting in loyalty increases over time while creating greater profits for the business along the way!

Understanding Shipping Delays: Causes and Solutions | OneLink Holdings

When your shipments are delayed, it can be frustrating and costly. Learn the most common causes of shipping delays and how to solve them.

Delays in shipping can be frustrating for businesses, especially when you’re relying on the timely delivery of a shipment for sales. Whether you’re an online business that relies on shipments to get your products to customers or a marketer managing the supply chain for a client, understanding the causes of shipping delays is essential. According to Bloomberg, in February 2022, only about 34% of container vessels arrived at their destination without any delays.

In this blog post, we’ll take a look at some of the most common problems that can cause shipments to be delayed and offer solutions for avoiding these issues in the future.

Shipping Conditions during COVID Pandemic

The theme of 2020 and 2021 was port congestions, nationwide lockdowns and shipping restrictions. One word, COVID. Unfortunately, this continued into 2022, with major backlogs in the shipping world. While there were plenty of ships and containers, the ports couldn’t keep up with the surge in demand; particularly from ecommerce brands, which resulted in clogged ports and slow circulation. Shipping conditions have improved off the back of COVID, with less congestion experienced from the second half of 2022.

Unexpected Weather Conditions

Unexpected weather conditions are one of the most common causes of shipping delays. Storms, hurricanes, snowstorms, and other extreme weather events can lead to road closures, flight cancellations, port closures, and other disruptions in the transportation system. While there’s no way to predict when these events will occur or how long they’ll last, it’s helpful to build extra time into your shipping timeline so that unexpected delays don’t disrupt your business operations.

Global Emergencies

Events that businesses cannot foresee are global emergencies such as pandemics, wars and other emergencies that lead to reduced shipping capacity. The most recent events to significantly halt international and domestic shipping was the COVID-19 pandemic. The war between Russia and Ukraine, and the growing tension between US and China are other examples of global emergencies.

Labour Disputes

Labour disputes can also cause shipments to be delayed. These disputes often take place between workers and employers or between union members and their unions. Labour disputes can include strikes, lockouts, slowdowns, and other work stoppages that prevent shipments from being delivered on time. To avoid delays caused by labour disputes, it’s important to stay informed about any labour issues that may affect your supply chain. It’s also helpful to have backup plans in place in case of a disruption in service. There is also an international shortage of workers, mainly due to the COVID pandemic, which means without people to do the job, delays are inevitable.

National and International Public Holidays

It is important to observe holidays throughout the year, both at a national and an international level. However, holidays also influence your shipping times. Some shipments may take longer to be processed due to holidays as carriers and delivery services may reduce their operations around these special days. It’s very important to factor holidays into planning for shipping dates and deliveries so that you can better estimate when customers will be receiving their orders. This can help you provide your customers with realistic expectations for delivery timelines and help ensure a positive customer experience with your business.

Port Congestion

Port congestion is another common problem that can lead to shipment delays. When ports become overcrowded due to increased demand for goods or changes in regulations, it can cause backlogs which lead to delayed shipments. To avoid port congestion-related delays, it’s important to plan ahead and make sure your shipments are ready well before they need to leave port so that they don’t get stuck waiting in line with other ships.

Incorrect or Incomplete Shipping Data

Putting the wrong delivery address, postcode or phone number can be enough to delay a shipment. Having the wrong import documentation can also mean delays or rejection at the import country port. Sending packages back can be costly to the seller and disappointing for the customer expecting the goods.

How do these delays affect customers?

Shipping delays can be a frustrating experience for customers because it affects the overall customer experience. Delays affect the excitement of getting a product in the hands of the customers and make the process much longer. Delays also lead to confusion and dissatisfaction when customers are not getting updates on their order status, or even more so when they have already paid for an item that is not showing up as quickly as expected.

What about businesses?

Shipping delays can cause all sorts of headaches for businesses. Missing a shipment means that businesses can’t provide customers with the goods or services that they were expecting. This disruption to the supply chain can delay production, delay the delivery of materials, or delay the launch of a new product. Businesses also have to deal with customer complaints and may have to offer discounts to make up for lost time and materials. Shipping delays put businesses in a tough spot; not only is their reputation on the line, but they’re potentially losing money too. To prevent this from happening, businesses should invest in reliable shipping services that are able to deliver goods fast and efficiently, minimising disruptions to supply chains and deliveries for customers who rely on timely service.

How can businesses mitigate risk from delayed deliveries?

To be prepared for potential delays, businesses need to factor some extra time into the shipping timeline. By allowing some extra days either side of delivery, it acts as a buffer incase of inclement weather, port congestion and any potential labour issues. For delays caused by public holidays, businesses should go through calendars and mark out public holidays. Any shipping needed to be done can be mapped out around these dates, to avoid the backlog that happens with public holidays. For global emergencies, which are often unforeseeable, communication with the customer is crucial. Consistently updating them on the situation provides some reassurance that their delivery is going to arrive eventually.

Delayed shipments can be costly for businesses and marketers alike. That’s why understanding the causes of shipping delays is essential for anyone involved in the supply chain process. By staying informed about potential weather issues, labour disputes, and port congestion and having backup plans in place just in case something goes wrong, you can help ensure that your shipments arrive on time without any hiccups along the way!

Designing Custom Packaging for Your Business | OneLink Holdings

Want to create custom packaging for your business? Here’s everything you need to know, from choosing the right materials to designing your labels.

A well-designed product package is an important tool for marketing and selling your products. It’s the first thing customers see when they receive your product, so it should be attractive, informative, and memorable. To create a custom packaging design that stands out from the competition and resonates with your target audience, you need to consider not only aesthetics but also practicality. When creating your custom packaging the most important aspects to consider are safety, design and recyclable paper and materials.

Why should businesses have their own custom packaging?

Businesses should invest in custom packaging for their products as it is a powerful marketing tool and improves customer experience. Even seemingly small packaging choices such as fonts, logos and colours can provide a distinct identity to customers, leading to recognition and brand loyalty. Custom packaging also communicates a company’s message more effectively than standard packaging because of its use of unique images, phrases or even design elements. Additionally, custom packaging can help create an emotional connection between customers and businesses with beautiful wrapping that conveys quality and creates an overall impressive look. In summary, customized packaging can make a considerable impact on the success of any business.

 


Most Common Types of Custom Packaging
Corrugated boxes

These boxes are the most common type of packaging box used worldwide. They are constructed of a sturdy, heavy duty material that consists of fluted sheets. They are very simple to construct and an economical choice for custom manufacturing.

Paperboard Boxes

These boxes are made from sheets of paper, which is notably strong but also lightweight. The added bonus of using paperboard boxes is it can be made from recycled waste paper. It can be easily folded to form various designs, shapes and sizes.

Plastic and Paper Mailers

Plastic and Paper mailers are the best eco-friendly packaging choice. Plastic mailers are made of polyethylene, which reduces the carbon emissions and protects the environment. Both packaging mailers are the perfect choice for your lightweight items such as apparel. While they are lightweight, they are strong enough to prevent any tearing, with the added bonus of being waterproof.

Poly Bags

Similar to the plastic and paper mailers, poly bags are also a great eco-friendly choice. They are lightweight, which is perfect for apparel and are waterproof and strong enough to withstand any tearing. You can customise these bags easily, often being able to completely change colours and add logos and design elements to the bags.

Let’s take a look at some of the factors you need to consider when designing your custom packaging:

Branding

The most obvious aspect of custom packaging design is branding. Your logo should be prominent on the package and should match up with any branding elements used in other promotional materials such as business cards, websites, etc… This helps establish your brand identity in the minds of consumers and makes it easier for them to recognize your products when they come across them in the future. The colours you use should also reflect your company’s values and image. Consistent branding across all customer touchpoints will help strengthen customer loyalty.

Internal Features

Adding in promo materials such as insert cards can be a great way to add an extra touch to your package. You could include discount codes, thankyou notes or even special offers. Some companies go a step further and add in sample products.

Functionality

Another important factor in custom packaging design is functionality. You want a package that does its job—protecting the product inside—while still being attractive enough to draw people’s attention. The material you choose for your package needs to be durable enough to protect whatever is inside from damage during shipping or storage, while still being lightweight to keep shipping costs down. You may also want to consider including additional features such as handles or windows that give customers a sneak peek at what’s inside!

Keep It Simple

Remember that less is more when it comes to custom packaging design. The simpler the design, the better it will look and function. Too many colours or intricate details can make it difficult for customers to focus on what really matters—your product! Keep things simple by using no more than two colours (three maximum), focusing on one main message (such as “quality guaranteed” or “trusted brand”) instead of trying to cram too many messages into a single package design. Additionally, limit text and graphics so that everything has room to breathe without feeling cramped or overcrowded.

Cost

Cost is an important deciding factor when choosing whether to do custom packaging or go for a generic, cheaper option. While some businesses will find custom packaging the best option, if your business is only shipping small quantities, you may be better off going for a generic box or satchel without your own custom design, as custom designs will cost more. There are several factors that determine the cost per custom designed box or satchel including colour, size, materials and quantity. Costs can be as little as 10c per package, increasing up to $10 per package.

Creating a successful custom packaging design requires careful consideration of both aesthetics and practicality. Make sure your brand logo is prominently displayed on the package, choose materials that are both protective and lightweight, keep things simple by limiting colours and text/graphics and always keep functionality at top of mind throughout the process. With these tips in mind, you can create an eye-catching package that communicates why customers should choose your product over others on the market!

5 Reasons to Relocate Your Supply Chain to Vietnam | OneLink Holdings

A great post on why you should relocate your supply chain to Vietnam. Learn the five reasons that make it a favourable choice for corporations looking to expand into Southeast Asia.

The global landscape of the supply chain industry is constantly shifting. Companies are always looking for new opportunities to streamline their processes, reduce costs, and increase efficiency. For many companies, relocating their supply chains is one way to achieve these goals. Vietnam is an emerging market that has a lot of potential as a destination for supply chain relocation. In this blog post, we’ll discuss five reasons why you should consider relocating your supply chain to Vietnam.

Top Industries relocating supply chains

The top 5 sectors in Vietnam that receive foreign investment were manufacturing and processing followed by real estate, electricity production, wholesale and retail and science and technology. Vietnam is currently more recognized as a popular manufacturing destination for industries such as clothing and textiles, furniture, food and beverage and footwear. They are beginning to shift focus to more advanced, High-Tec manufacturing; mainly involving electronics. This is due to the increased investment offers. In 2021, 1738 new foreign investment projects were granted investment registration certificates.

Labour Availability and Cost

One of the major advantages of relocating your supply chain to Vietnam is the low cost of labour and the large pool of available workers. In July 2022, minimum wages increased an average of 6%. While still considered quite low compared to other countries, this was considered a significant increase. Minimum wages in Vietnam vary due to the location of the worker and whether the organisation is state-owned, with the government dividing the country into 4 regions. The first type of minimum wage is referred to as the ‘common minimum wage’ which is used for employees in state-owned organizations and enterprises. The wage is VND 1,490,000 (~US$64) per month.

The second type of minimum wage is used for non-state-owned organisations and enterprises. This minimum wage is based on zones as defined by the government. Workers in region 1; urban Ho Chi Minh City, receive the highest hourly and monthly salary of $US 0.97 per hour and US$ 202 per month whereas workers in region 4; the provincial cities and districts not mentioned in other regions receive $US 0.67 per hour and US$ 140 per month.

The labour availability is considered one of the largest in the ASEAN region, with 56 million people and a labour participation rate of 76%. Highly skilled employees can be difficult to find, with only 12% considered highly skilled. This will change, with the government setting a target of creating 1.3 million IT workers by 2025.

With its large population and low wages, Vietnam can provide much lower labour costs than other countries in the region—including China—making it an attractive option for businesses looking to cut costs.

Proximity To Major Markets:

Another benefit of relocating your supply chain to Vietnam is its proximity to some of the world’s largest markets, including India, Japan, South Korea and China. This allows businesses easy access to these lucrative markets when they are ready to export their goods or services. With China as a bordering country, Vietnam has access to the world’s largest consumer markets and top suppliers of intermediate inputs such as raw materials, without the expensive shipping needed to obtain these goods. Japan and Korea also make use of the convenient shipping, using Vietnam to outsource parts of their supply chain.

Vietnam is also a member of the World Trade Organisation, with 17 current free trade agreements (FTAs) in place, making it one of the most open economies in South East Asia. These bilateral and multilateral agreements connect Vietnam with many countries and regions including Australia, Brunei, Burma, Cambodia, Canada, China, Chile, Indonesia, Japan, Laos, Mexico, Malaysia, New Zealand, Philippines, South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, United Kingdom, European Union Countries and Eurasian Economic Union countries. By having access to Free Trade Agreements, Vietnam can gain knowledge and the technology needed through foreign firms to transition into higher value-added production capabilities.

Find out more about Vietnam’s Free Trade Agreements in our previous blog.

Favourable Tax System:

The Vietnamese government also offers favourable tax rates for businesses that relocate their operations there—including corporate income tax rates as low as 10%. Companies invested in high-tech sectors, particular industrial zones and the underdeveloped socio-economic regions can access these reduced tax rates, along with certain tax holidays. The government also provides incentives in regard to Project Size and investment. The industries which the Vietnam Government are encouraging with incentives include education, health care, sport, high technology, environmental protection, scientific research and technology development, infrastructural development, processing of agricultural and aquatic products, software production and renewable energy.

Foreign Firms that make new investments in technology-related sectors, garments, footwear, automobiles, as well as goods produced domestically and goods that meet the EU quality standard can be taxed at 10% for 15 years, which also includes a tax holiday for the first 4 years, and a 50% reduction in the tax rate for the nine subsequent years.

The Incentives for project size have two criteria, with either one needing to be fulfilled to obtain tax benefits. Companies that invest more than VND6 Trillion (US $261 million) in the first three years of being licensed OR companies that invest capital of more than VND12 trillion within the first 5 years of being licensed and by using prescribed high technology can qualify for a tax rate of 10% for 15 years, with a tax holiday for the first 4 years, followed by 50% tax reduction for the subsequent 9 years.

Along with the Corporate Tax rates, there are other benefits such as Land Rental incentives and Customs Duty incentives. This makes it a great option for businesses looking to save money on taxes while still doing business overseas.

Political Environment

Vietnam has a stable political and business environment; with the government promoting a friendly environment for foreign investors. This makes it easier for foreign businesses and investors who want to operate in the country without having to worry about navigating complex regulations or dealing with lengthy paperwork processes.

With political stability and strong leadership, Vietnam is an attractive destination for foreign companies looking to move operations. Its political climate is characterized by positive policy reforms and economic development initiatives as well as improved transparency and accountability standards, which ensure consistency for businesses investing in Vietnam. The government also places a strong emphasis on creating a dynamic business and investment environment through favourable tax laws and streamlined business regulations. With political stability at the forefront of this attractive environment, foreign companies can have confidence that their venture into the Vietnamese market will come with reliable returns and long-term rewards.

China +1 and a China alternative

Businesses who use China as a primary manufacturing country are increasingly choosing Vietnam to supplement China operations. This is due to the low-cost inputs that can be sourced from production facilities in Vietnam. The China +1 strategy involves investors shifting or expanding from China into Vietnam to increase market access and to mitigate vulnerabilities in existing supply chains. This has particularly been useful due to China COVID disruptions, that have continued to cause havoc with manufacturers in China.

The geopolitical tensions and higher costs in China have been pushing firms to move their supply chains into Vietnam completely. The US-China Trade war has significantly impacted the environment in China, with many US and EU firms opting to reduce or eliminate dealing with Chinese manufacturers altogether.

As you can see from this overview, there are several compelling reasons why you should consider relocating your supply chain operations from your current location into Vietnam if you haven’t already done so already! Keep in mind though that before making any decisions about where you should relocate your operations, it’s important that you do your own research into all potential options so that you make an informed decision based on all available information at hand!

All You Need to Know About Finding and Manufacturing Home Décor in Vietnam | OneLink Holdings

Here is a guide on how you can source and manufacture home décor in Vietnam. Find out what steps you need to take, the cost involved, where to source from, etc.

Vietnam has become a key player in the home décor and home goods industry, offering an array of products that are both high quality and cost effective. There are many advantages to sourcing your home décor and home goods from Vietnam, including access to a wide range of materials, skilled labour, and competitive pricing. In this blog post, we will delve into all you need to know about finding and manufacturing home décor and home goods in Vietnam.

What Home Décor Products are manufactured in Vietnam

Due to the abundance of vine-like species native to tropical areas, Vietnam uses predominately bamboo, sturdy grass and rattan when manufacturing home décor. These materials are sustainable and grow quite quickly. Bamboo also does not require much water and does not need to be sprayed with pesticides or fertilizers

Vietnam is known for manufacturing the following home décor products:

  • Bamboo products
  • Coconut products
  • Wall art
  • Storage baskets
  • Photo frames
  • Vases
  • Candleholders
  • Wickers products
  • Rattan products
Finding Suppliers in Vietnam

The best way to find suppliers in Vietnam is through an online search engine such as Alibaba or Global Sources. Once you have found potential suppliers, it is important to do your due diligence when selecting the right supplier for your needs. Make sure you read reviews from previous customers and check out the company’s website for more information on their services. You should also contact the supplier directly with any questions you may have before making a decision. Another alternative to finding suppliers is using a sourcing agent such as our company, OneLink Holdings. We will contact suppliers on your behalf and obtain quotes and samples. Once you are happy with your product design, we oversee the manufacturing process, ensuring high quality products are being produced. Once manufacturing is complete, we then organise freight and logistics on your behalf.

Top Home Décor Suppliers Vietnam

While there are several home décor manufacturers located throughout Vietnam, we have identified the most popular manufacturers.

Son Tra Craft

Son Tra Craft is located in Son Tra, Da Nang and specialise in handcrafted homeware and décor accessories as well as giftware. They use eco-friendly materials in all products and utilizes environmentally friendly manufacturing processes. Some of the handcrafted items they produce include lampshades, kitchenware, home decorations, storage baskets, cremation urns and painted wall art.

Lavihex

Lavihex is also located in Da Nang, Vietnam and specialise in the development, design and production of home décor items. They produce items such as home furnishings, wall art, photo and mirror frames, vases, tableware, serving trays and candleholders.

Handitex Handicraft Export

Located in Hanoi, Vietnam, Handitex Handicraft Export produces home décor items made of sustainable and eco-friendly materials such as bamboo, seagrass and rattan. Décor items in production include wall décor, lamps and lanterns, rattan storage baskets and garden pots and centrepieces.

Manufacturing Home Décor & Home Goods

Once you have found a reliable supplier, it’s time to start manufacturing your home décor & home goods. In order to ensure your products are of high quality, it is important to specify exactly what materials you want used in production. When evaluating potential suppliers, ask about their production methods—are they using traditional methods or modern technologies? It is also important to discuss lead times as well as shipping costs so that there are no surprises down the line. Finally, make sure that all of your requirements are clearly laid out in a contract before any work begins.

Quality Control & Assurance

When it comes to manufacturing products for export purposes, quality control is an absolute must! Make sure that the supplier offers quality control services throughout the entire process—from raw material inspection all the way through final product inspection prior to shipment. It is also important that they use international standards such as ISO9001 or ICTI certification so that you can be confident that their processes meet industry requirements.

Vietnam has become an increasingly popular choice for sourcing home décor & home goods due its access to materials, skilled labour force, competitive pricing structure, and quality results. When searching for suppliers in Vietnam it’s important to do your due diligence beforehand so that you can select one who meets your needs while still providing excellent service at a reasonable price point. Once you have found the right supplier, make sure all your requirements are laid out clearly in a contract before beginning production – including specifying exact materials used as well as details about lead times and shipping costs – so that there can be no surprises later on down the line! Finally, don’t forget about quality control; make sure that any potential supplier offers international standards like ISO9001 or ICTI certification when it comes time for inspections! With these tips in mind, clients & marketers should feel comfortable sourcing their home décor & home goods from manufacturers located in Vietnam!
